title: docs(app-shell): the organization administrator creates and removes Setup holders
body:
Fixes #13119
Clause-②: no

## What

objectstack's shipped `organization_admin` (and `organization_admin_no_bypass`) now creates and removes rows on `sys_user_position` and `sys_user_permission_set` and never edits them (`allowCreate: true`, `allowDelete: true`, `allowEdit: false`), bounded server-side by the delegated-administration gate (its own organization, its own members, in-boundary sets only). objectstack-ai/objectstack#24732 landed it at `b27f8ded5c`, and objectui's `.objectstack-sha` (`06cab4849a`) carries it.

Four places here still said that administrator is read-only on both assignment objects and cited a retired objectstack pin. They now say what ships and cite the successor pin, `organization_admin creates and removes assignment rows, never edits them — both variants` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/rbac-objects.test.ts`, read at `06cab4849a`):

- `packages/app-shell/README.md`, "The Setup half of an item" (published in `@object-ui/app-shell`'s `files[]`, so it gets a `patch` changeset);
- the comments above `canAdd` / `canRemove` in `AssignedUsersSection.tsx` and `PositionHoldersSection.tsx`;
- `setupHoldersGrant-12082.test.tsx`: the header, and the `ORG_ADMIN` fixture, which is now the shipped shape (create and delete true, edit false, beside the super-user wildcard).

**No behaviour change.** Add still reads `relatedNew` (the create grant) and Remove still reads `relatedRowDelete` (the delete grant); neither reads `allowEdit`. Section logic is untouched.

## Pins

- (a) An organization administrator with the shipped grant is offered Add (and the picker it feeds) and Remove, in both sections. This passed against the unchanged sections, which confirms the client already does the right thing for the new grant.
- (b) CONTROL: the same super-user wildcard beside explicit entries with neither create nor delete (the old read-only shape) is offered neither. The explicit entry still governs. The existing `read-only` / `create-only` / `delete-only` / `full` matrix and the no-provider control are unchanged.

## Verification (at `ae98638bcf`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/setupHoldersGrant-12082.test.tsx` from the repo root, under the shared lock: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 20 passed (20)`.
- Closure build `turbo run build --filter="@object-ui/app-shell^..." --concurrency=2` (28/28 tasks) then `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. `--listFilesOnly` on `tsconfig.test.json` lists all three edited `.tsx` files.
- `eslint --format json` on the three edited `.tsx` files: 3 files, 0 errors. Type-aware linting is off in `eslint.config.js` (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot change any verdict on an untouched file.
- The pre-tsc battery (`check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`), `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs` and `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`: all exit 0.
- Declared to CI: the full `packages/app-shell/` test directory. Locally only the edited test file ran.
